citation_entries_site_or_custom_check.name: citation_entries_site_or_custom_check
citation_entries_site_or_custom_check.value: ("citation_entries"."site_key" IS NOT NULL AND "citation_entries"."custom_name" IS NULL AND "citation_entries"."custom_url" IS NULL) OR ("citation_entries"."site_key" IS NULL AND "citation_entries"."custom_name" IS NOT NULL)

grid_configs_grid_size_check.name: grid_configs_grid_size_check
grid_configs_grid_size_check.value: ("grid_configs"."kind" = 'keyword_rank' AND "grid_configs"."grid_size" = 1) OR ("grid_configs"."kind" <> 'keyword_rank' AND "grid_configs"."grid_size" BETWEEN 3 AND 13 AND "grid_configs"."grid_size" % 2 = 1)
